assertions.name: benchmark_execution
assertions.requirement: all 20 mixed and 40 complete-null pathway simulations complete

assertions.name: locked_runtime_identity
assertions.requirement: all replicates use R 4.6.1, edgeR 4.10.0, and limma 3.68.0

assertions.name: fixture_byte_determinism
assertions.requirement: representative simulation, truth, membership, GMT, and annotation bytes rerun identically

assertions.name: limma_mroast_complete_null_family_fdr_gate
assertions.requirement: at most 4 of 40 complete-null families reject

assertions.name: limma_fry_complete_null_family_fdr_gate
assertions.requirement: at most 4 of 40 complete-null families reject

assertions.name: python_bh_parity
assertions.requirement: Python BH per contrast/method/hypothesis agrees within 1e-12

metrics.gross_regression_limitation: Frozen finite Monte Carlo scenarios detect gross calibration/power regressions; they do not establish universal pathway-test error control or biological power.
metrics.membership_construction: A separate frozen RNG samples truth-null genes without replacement within each null set; positive sets are disjoint within direction and sample pure truth-DE genes without using counts, fitted statistics, p-values, or ranks.
metrics.null_family_metric: Per complete-null replicate and method, the family outcome is one if any of 100 BH-adjusted directional tests rejects, otherwise zero.

thresholds.mroast_seed_policy: The production seed is reset per contrast and is intentionally independent of simulation and membership RNG streams; sharing it across replicates can induce Monte Carlo dependence, so complete-null evidence is a gross-regression gate.
